$comment: Operational limits both runtimes must agree on. providerJobDeliveryLimit is the quorum queue x-delivery-limit the backend declares on provider.jobs and provider.video.jobs (MediaTopologyConfig.JOB_DELIVERY_LIMIT) and the delivery count at which the provider worker answers a transient failure with a terminal error (provider/__main__.py MAX_TRANSIENT_REDELIVERIES). Equal values make the worker's terminal result arrive on the last delivery the broker still performs; a worker value above the broker's means the broker dead-letters first and the backend never receives a result. Accepted residual: when publishing that terminal result itself fails on the last delivery, the job is requeued, the broker dead-letters the next delivery and the backend fails the step only at its queue timeout (provider-queue-timeout, or provider-video-queue-timeout for a clip). productVideoDurationSeconds is the length of the rendered Product Video: the worker renders to it (handlers/render_video.py TARGET_DURATION_SECONDS) and the backend fails a generate_speech step whose durationMs is above it with code speech_too_long (ProductVideoWorkflow.VIDEO_DURATION_SECONDS), because the renderer would cut that speech off.
